title: Software Development
description: Starter practice for Git workflow and software-quality fundamentals.

questions.question: Which Git command copies a remote repository onto your computer?
questions.explanation: git clone creates a local copy and configures the remote.

questions.question: What does git add -A do before a commit?
questions.explanation: Staging selects the current changes that the next commit will record.

questions.question: Why make changes on a development branch before merging into main?
options: To isolate work until it is ready
questions.explanation: A branch isolates a line of work so it can be reviewed or tested before integration.

questions.question: Which quality is primarily concerned with how easily developers can understand source code?
questions.explanation: Readability is a developer-oriented quality that supports understanding and maintenance.

questions.question: Which is mainly a user-facing software quality?
questions.explanation: Correctness concerns whether the software behaves according to its requirements.

questions.question: What does the single-responsibility principle encourage?
options: One component should have one focused reason to change
Every class should contain all program logic
Tests should be removed after coding
Names should be as short as possible
questions.explanation: A focused responsibility makes components easier to understand, test, and change.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a unit test?
options: Test a focused program component against expected behavior
questions.explanation: Unit tests check small components in isolation or near-isolation.

questions.question: What does refactoring aim to change?
options: The internal structure while preserving observable behavior
questions.explanation: Refactoring improves design without intentionally changing external behavior.
